per_window.ps-ns: Unresolved, abstract-only throughout. Apo (variant not stated): the C-terminal loop G57-E60 has lower order parameters than in metal-bound states (J12, r2); Cd2+ in site II raises them (J14, r3); Ca2+-loaded averages S2 0.83 (loops), 0.85 (helices), 0.59 (linker) (J16, r1); methyls split into proximal and distal classes on Ca2+ binding (J20, J21, r17, r18); an engineered-loop mutant is stiffer than P43G (J34, r14).
per_window.us-ms: Unresolved, abstract-only. Apo and (Cd2+)1 states show slower fluctuations in the empty N-terminal loop, faster with Cd2+ (J13, J15; r2, r3). Dicalcium and Ca/La P43M show millisecond equilibria in the linker (38, 42-44, 46) and site I (18, 19) by R1rho (J27, J28; r22, r23), lost in 2 M GdmHCl (J29; r39, r40). No dispersion or R1rho study of P43G or of the native protein is in the evidence.
per_window.slower_than_ms: Native Pro43 calbindin (Ca2+-loaded) has two peak sets, 3:1, linked by Gly42-Pro43 cis/trans isomerism with cis-to-trans 0.2 s-1 at 25 °C (J1; r4, r9, r36; abstracts). The entry construct P43G shows no second peak set (J6; r5, r10). Wild type and P43G do not form domain-swapped dimers in crystallization drops, while P43M variants do over days (J5, J11, J31).
per_window.undetermined: Hydrogen exchange: apo amides exchange on average 220-fold faster than in the Ca2+ form, Ca2+ and Cd2+ protect many amides (J17-J19); apo P43G shows faster amide exchange and ring rotation (J7). Static or indirect: crystal cis/trans conformers (J2), minor A form fold (J3), Ca2+ off-rate 3 s-1 (J4, binding kinetics), apo, Ca2+ and Cd2+ P43G structures (J8-J10), DPC micelle and DPC binding (J22, J23), lanthanide restraints and Ce3+ substitution kinetics (J24), apo/holo comparison (J25), deamidation isoforms as an artefact lead (J26), N56A, E65Q and F36G/P43M mutants (J30, J32, J33), frozen 19F-ENDOR (J35). Not judged: Ca2+-exchange mutants M1-M4 (r25-r28), lysine methylation (r35), pseudo-EF-hand mutants (CD9K-CD9K_20261020030739-r2), Mg2+- and Mn2+-bound crystals of an unstated variant (CD9K-CD9K_20261020030739-r6, r7), E60D crystal (CD9K-CD9K_20261020030739-r8), homolog comparison (CD9K-CD9K_20261020030739-r9) and the P43MG tether-helix mutant (CD9K-CD9K_20261020030739-r16).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Unknown: no readable study measures microsecond-millisecond exchange in Ca2+-free calbindin D9k of either the native Pro43 sequence or the entry's P43G variant; the only apo relaxation study is read as an abstract (11.74 T, variant not stated) and reports slower fluctuations in the empty N-terminal binding loop with no residues, rate or population, and the slow cis/trans exchange with two peak sets belongs to native Pro43 calbindin in the Ca2+-loaded state, not to P43G.
open_conflicts: Construct of the apo relaxation study (r2): its abstract names no variant, but the 1998 engineered-loop abstract (r14 source) calls the earlier apo study P43G; the judgments keep r2 as 'variant not stated'.

Native apo heterogeneity: the apo P43G assignment abstract (r11 source) says the wild type was not assigned because of conformational heterogeneity, which suggests cis/trans peak doubling also in the apo native protein, but no row shows apo peak sets or a rate.
questions_for_gina: Which sample is the RelaxDB CD9K entry: apo or Ca2+-loaded, and is it the P43G variant (the entry sequence carries G43) from the 1992 Ca2+-loaded or 1993 apo/(Cd2+)1 15N relaxation studies?

For the alternate-APO table, should the P43G entry construct be the reference (no cis/trans isomerism) or should native Pro43 calbindin count, where two peak sets in slow exchange are reported in the Ca2+-loaded state?
protein_summary.buffer_note: Almost every calbindin row is abstract-only, so temperature, pH and buffer are mostly unknown; r15 and r16 state pH 7.5 and 25 °C. The full-text domain-swapping work (B-r18 to B-r25) is in acidic, concentrated crystallization drops (pH about 4.8-5.5, ammonium sulfate, Ca2+, sometimes 100 mM Mg2+) and does not describe solution NMR conditions. The ENDOR rows are frozen at 10 K with Gd3+ in a Ca2+ site. is_wt_apo is false for every judgment: no apo row concerns the native Pro43 protein, and P43G rows are labelled as the mutant they are. Row-id shorthand: B-rN = CD9K-CD9K_20261020030739-rN.
